GreedFall: The Dying World - Peren's Black Mass Pack

name: GreedFall: The Dying World - Peren's Black Mass Pack
summary:
In this pack, you will discover an exclusive quest, a new outfit and a weapon with a unique look.

A rumour is spreading through the streets of Peren. The lush sister city of Sérène seems to be the place for forbidden rituals.

Follow the trail of a corrupt faith, confront the darkness…and discover how far some people will go to gain power.

This pack includes:
• An exclusive quest: Cardinal Pius needs your help to investigate mysterious Black Masses that are causing unrest in the city.
• A "Black Mass" outfit: an alternative, darker version of the Thélème garb.
• A "Black Magic" version of the Thélème rings: an ancient weapon which grants formidable magical power.
